newsitem.title: USA: Falcon Drilling says no damage to rig.
newsitem.headline: Falcon Drilling says no damage to rig.

text.p: Falcon Drilling Co Inc said on Monday a natural gas well blowout in the Gulf of Mexico had done no damage to its mobile drilling rig.

Chief financial officer Bob Fulton told Reuters the well, owned by Houston Exploration Co, blew out during the completion phase, but "there was not a fire or anything like that." Asked if the Falcon rig used to drill the well had suffered any damage, he said, "None."
A Coast Guard spokesman said the well had broken off above water and was spewing natural gas, but no oil. A well control team had been brought in to try to cap the well, he said.
All 39 workers on the rig, located about 40 miles southeast of Cameron, La., escaped in a rescue capsule aboard the rig, the Coast Guard said.
